data.description:
## Context

The code-review documentation specialist declares `execution_mode: single_turn`, while its routing entry declares `exec: 1-TURN`. The runner therefore withholds repository tools. Its rubric also requires every contradiction to appear entirely inside the diff. This prevents grounded detection when a changed public contract requires an update to maintained documentation. The rubric does not apply the documentation roles and correction rules in `docs/documentation-policy.md`.

The approved design upgrades this specialist to the same agentic execution model used by other repository-grounded code-review criteria. It preserves advisory treatment and rejects stylistic enforcement.

## Plan

- Change the prompt execution mode to `agentic` and the routing execution mode to `AGENT`. Regenerate the derived reviewer index from prompt front matter.
- Revise the documentation rubric to require read-only repository navigation before reporting missing updates or role violations.
- Replace the diff-only contradiction rule with a two-source rule. Every finding must cite a changed `path:line` and a second repository source that proves inaccuracy, required ownership, or a bounded omission.
- Add a missing-update check for changed user, operator, API, CLI, configuration, and shipped-help contracts. Permit absence findings only when repository evidence establishes the canonical documentation location and a bounded search confirms the omission. A repository-wide search with no match is insufficient.
- Add a documentation-role check based on `docs/documentation-policy.md` and `docs/generated-artifacts.md`. Apply it to changed maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, ADRs, and generated artifacts. Require policy citations and abstention when audience, role, or ownership is ambiguous.
- Preserve the existing automatic file globs, advisory posture, blocking setting, impact-aware nit suppression, and independent Pass 2 verification. Do not add punctuation, character, vocabulary, diction, tone, wrapping, or subjective concision enforcement.
- Add balanced prompt regression cases and contract tests for agentic execution, grounded missing-update findings, role violations, protected evidence, and false-positive abstention.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The documentation overlay front matter, routing entry, and generated reviewer index agree that the overlay uses agentic execution with repository tools.
- [ ] The rubric requires every finding to contain a changed-text anchor and repository-backed evidence.
- [ ] Missing-update findings require a repository-proven documentation obligation and a bounded search. Generic absence speculation remains prohibited.
- [ ] Documentation-role findings apply the explicit role and correction rules in `docs/documentation-policy.md` and generated ownership in `docs/generated-artifacts.md`. Ambiguous roles produce no finding.
- [ ] Protected evidence, quotations, historical ticket events, ADR decision substance, and writing-style preferences remain outside the criterion.
- [ ] Existing routing globs, advisory posture, blocking setting, nit suppression, and Pass 2 verification remain unchanged.
- [ ] Balanced regression coverage includes proven missing updates and role violations, plus internal-only changes, ambiguous ownership, and unrelated unchanged documentation that must produce no finding.
- [ ] Focused prompt, routing, index, and regression tests pass, followed by repository lint and type checks.
data.title: Make the code-review documentation overlay agentic
